امتحنتن (form VIII)
# اِمْتَحَنْتُنَّ (imtaḥantunna) /im.ta.ħan.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِمْتَحَنَ (imtaḥana)
# اُمْتُحِنْتُنَّ (umtuḥintunna) /um.tu.ħin.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِمْتَحَنَ (imtaḥana)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
